description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance of three different language models under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, ordered by increasing size: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical value axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to over 80, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 10. For each model category, a group of four vertical bars is arranged side-by-side. According to the legend in the bottom right, these bars represent different fine-tuning stages: "no SFT" (blue-grey with top-left to bottom-right diagonal hatching), "+ SFT on $D_0$" (tan with horizontal hatching), "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" (purple-grey with bottom-left to top-right diagonal hatching), and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" (solid reddish-brown). Across the chart, the lowest values are observed in the LLaMA-2-7B group for the "no SFT" and "+ SFT on $D_0$" conditions, both at approximately 66%. The highest values reach approximately 85% for the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" condition in both the LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B groups. In the LLaMA-2-7B group, the solid reddish-brown bar reaches approximately 84%. In the LLaMA-2-13B group, values start at approximately 70% for "no SFT" and peak at roughly 85% for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$". In the LLaMA-2-70B group, all values are relatively high and closely grouped, ranging from approximately 81% to 85%. The categories are sorted by model parameter size, and visual distinction is provided through the specific hatching patterns applied to the first three bars of each group, contrasting with the solid fill of the fourth bar.
